import_provenance.original_title: Blind signatures from one-way functions alone
import_provenance.original_statement: Does the existence of one-way functions imply classical blind signatures in the plain model, with blindness and one-more unforgeability against polynomial-time adversaries? Allow arbitrary polynomially many rounds and non-black-box techniques, but no trusted setup or ideal random oracle.
import_provenance.supplied_caveat: Remark: Editorial continuation of Chaum’s blind-signature primitive. The 2011 impossibility concerns black-box constructions; the 2026 OWF-based construction uses a global non-programmable random oracle and therefore does not settle the plain-model question.
